notes:
v4.6.29 — Make Bot broker selector (Alpaca / IBKR)

✨ NEW
• Make Bot now has a Broker selector: Alpaca (stocks + crypto, API keys) or IBKR (Interactive Brokers, TWS/Gateway). The choice drives which SDK the generated bot uses and which credentials it requests — so bots stop forgetting they're supposed to trade on Alpaca.
• Broker-specific generation prompt: Alpaca bots get the load_dotenv + ALPACA_API_KEY + TradingClient(paper=…) rules; IBKR bots get ib_insync + ib.connect(port, clientId) + 'never import alpaca' rules. The right .txt guidance is sent to the AI based on the selection.
• META.broker is stamped into every generated bot and stored in the bot registry. The broker-mode switch (top-right) now hides custom bots whose broker doesn't match — so flipping to IBKR shows only IBKR bots, and the Overview reflects the active broker.
• Universe generators stay broker-agnostic (they only write a .txt).

Includes v4.6.28's universe_manager auth fix + bot-lifetime metrics + optimal-value backbone.
